summary: Parallel skip-ahead initialization is outside timing; it does not replace timed products. All local CSR entries are multiplied on every requested repetition.

source_evidence.claim: Balanced complete row partitions construct their local CSR data before timing. The parsed -i count directly bounds full spmvCpu calls, separately from optional reference computation.
